interface.signature: def Reduced_String(k: int, s: str) -> str:

preconditions.description: k is a positive integer within the bounds of the string length.
The input string s has length between 1 and 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(len(group) < k or group[0] != group[1] for group in [s[i:i+k] for i in range(len(s)-k+1)])
postconditions.description: No group of k consecutive identical characters exists in the returned string.

postconditions.expression: all(s[i] == return_value[i] or (i+k <= len(s) and s[i] == s[i+k-1] and all(s[i+j] == s[i] for j in range(k)) and return_value[i:i+k-1] == return_value[i+k-1:]) for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: The returned string is obtained by iteratively removing all possible groups of k consecutive identical characters from s until no more such groups exist.
